raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 22
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly assumed that the presence of an “[other]” link on the arXiv listing implied a .ps (PostScript) version was available for each paper and thus concluded all 97 entries had .ps files. They did not verify the “Other formats” page for each article or use the API to confirm .ps availability. This misinterpretation led to the overcount; the correct number is 31.
